fields.Name: IT164 - Work Bus Core Layers
fields.Description: Deterministic integration checks (WBC1-WBC10) for MJ 6.3 Work Bus & Software Factory core layers with zero LLM calls and zero Open App dependency. Covers MJ: Conversation Types & virtual Conversation.Type parity, type-row ExtensionEntity IS-A validation, 2-level IS-A chain saves (Field Suggestion -> Comment -> Conversation), OnSubtypeChange='Refuse' vs promotion, AllowedCommentTypes opt-in gating, newer-suggestion superseding, AcceptFieldSuggestion / RejectFieldSuggestion authorization and writeback, FieldSuggestionPostSaveHook direct-edit superseding, AnchoredConversationPostRunViewHook security across IS-A views, and AgentWakeTriggerService.TriggerWakeForWorkstream coalescing + Schedule Next Agent Wake gate alias normalization.

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: All 10 WBC checks pass deterministically: IS-A subtypes auto-ensure and guard against subtype drift, Field Suggestions enforce entity opt-in and record permissions, direct field edits supersede pending suggestions, and workstream agent wakes coalesce cleanly.
